key_idea: Count the small grid steps along each path.
steps: Each path is made of short pieces, each one square side long. Count them.
The green path C goes down 3, right 4, up 3, left 2 and down 2. That is 3 + 4 + 3 + 2 + 2 = 14.
Path A has 11 pieces, path B has 12, path D has 13 and path E has 13.
14 is the biggest, so path C is the longest.

choice_feedback.A: Path A has 11 pieces, fewer than 14.
choice_feedback.B: Path B has 12 pieces, fewer than 14.
choice_feedback.D: Path D has 13 pieces, 1 fewer than path C.
choice_feedback.E: Path E has 13 pieces, 1 fewer than path C.
